title: Peaceful Sleep
subtitle: Calm your mind, soothe your heart, and sleep seeking His refuge.
audioError: Audio couldn't load. Please check your internet.
forgivenMsg: Your heart is at ease. May Allah grant you comfort.

premiumGate.title: Free trial used
premiumGate.desc: You have tried Sleep Mode once for free. Upgrade to Premium for unlimited access.

controls.title: Play and repeat
controls.body: The gold button starts Surah Al-Mulk. The loop button next to it restarts it at the end — it keeps going until you fall asleep.

rain.title: Rain sound
rain.body: It can play alongside the Qur'an. Turn both on and find the mix you like.

forgive.title: Close the day clean
forgive.body: Say that you forgive whatever others owe you. Once a day.
